en.title: WHAT IS BAZI?
en.subtitle: A structured view of pattern and timing derived from birth data.
en.body:
BaZi builds a four-pillar structure from the year, month, day, and hour of birth. Through the Heavenly Stems, Earthly Branches, Five Elements, and the relationships between them, it describes the configuration associated with a particular birth moment.

Rather than reducing a person to a single personality label, BaZi examines how different elements combine, support, constrain, and transform one another. The Four Pillars establish the base structure, the Five Elements show distribution and interaction, seasonal context helps frame the configuration, and timing layers show how different themes may become more or less emphasized across different periods.

BaZi is a structured reading system. It can offer a perspective on pattern, relationships, resources, pressure, and timing, but its projection is not the whole of a person's Reality and does not by itself prove that a particular event must occur.
keyBlocks: Read the four pillars, seasonal context and registered relationships as an interpretive structure.
en.boundary: Interpretive presentation, not objective proof or a prediction.

zh-Hans.title: 什么是八字？
zh-Hans.subtitle: 从出生时间建立一套结构与时间关系图。
zh-Hans.body:
八字以出生的年、月、日、时建立四柱结构，并通过天干、地支、五行及它们之间的关系，描述一个人在特定出生时间下形成的结构配置。它关注的不是单一性格标签，而是不同元素如何组合、支持、牵制与变化，以及这些关系怎样随着时间周期出现不同的强调。

在实际读取中，四柱提供基础结构，五行显示不同元素之间的分布与关系，月令与整体配置帮助判断结构所处的季节与环境背景，后续时间层则用来观察不同阶段中哪些主题被进一步放大、减弱或重新组织。

八字是一种结构化读取方法。它可以提供关于格局、关系、资源、压力与时间变化的视角，但这些结果本身并不等于一个人的全部现实，也不能单独证明某件事情一定会发生。
keyBlocks: 把四柱、季节背景和已登记的关系作为解释性结构来阅读。
zh-Hans.boundary: 解释性呈现，不是客观证明或预测。

en.title: WHY HAS BAZI ENDURED?
en.subtitle: It endured through centuries of refinement, interpretation, and practice as a structured language for examining birth patterns and change over time.
en.body:
BaZi did not emerge as a complete system at a single moment in history. It developed from long-standing Chinese traditions for organizing time through the sexagenary cycle, calendrical structure, yin–yang relationships, and the Five Elements. Over time, these ideas were increasingly organized around the year, month, day, and hour of birth, forming the Four Pillars framework and its later approaches to structure and timing.

Across different periods, practitioners refined terminology, interpretive rules, and schools of reading. The same structural configuration can therefore be interpreted differently within different traditions. BaZi has endured not simply because it is old, but because the relationships among pillars, elements, seasons, and timing created a repeatable framework that could be calculated, recorded, compared, debated, and transmitted across generations.

Long transmission demonstrates enduring cultural and interpretive value. It does not, by itself, establish every traditional interpretation as an empirically verified fact. A contemporary reading should therefore distinguish calculated structure from inherited interpretation, and inherited interpretation from what can actually be observed in Reality.
keyBlocks: Read the four pillars, seasonal context and registered relationships as an interpretive structure.
en.boundary: Interpretive presentation, not objective proof or a prediction.

zh-Hans.title: 为什么八字会传承至今？
zh-Hans.subtitle: 它经历了长期整理、解释与实践，逐渐形成一套以出生时间观察结构与变化的语言。
zh-Hans.body:
八字并不是在某一个时刻突然完成的体系。它建立在中国长期使用干支纪年、历法、阴阳与五行关系来组织时间和变化的传统之上，后来逐渐发展出以出生年、月、日、时建立四柱，并通过干支、五行、季节与时间周期进行结构读取的方法。

随着不同时代的整理与传承，八字的术语、判断规则与流派不断发展，同一个结构也可能出现不同解释。它之所以能够长期延续，并不只是因为“历史悠久”，而是因为四柱、五行、季节与时间之间形成了一套可以重复计算、记录、比较与讨论的结构语言，使不同世代的人能够继续在同一套框架中提出关于关系、资源、阶段与变化的问题。

长期传承说明八字具有持续的文化与解释价值，但并不意味着每一个传统判断都因此成为经过现代实证验证的事实。今天使用八字，更重要的是分清哪些属于计算结构、哪些属于历史形成的解释，以及这些解释是否真的能够在现实中被观察和检验。
keyBlocks: 把四柱、季节背景和已登记的关系作为解释性结构来阅读。
zh-Hans.boundary: 解释性呈现，不是客观证明或预测。
zh-Hans.alt: 为什么八字会传承至今？

en.title: HOW DOES PHI OS USE BAZI?
en.subtitle: Preserve the structural reading, then place it back into Reality.
en.body:
PHI OS does not treat BaZi as a complete or absolute explanation of a person's life. It treats BaZi as one structured perspective on configuration and timing.

The BaZi method remains responsible for its own calculation, Four Pillars, Five Element relationships, and timing structure. PHI OS does not recalculate or replace those rules, and it does not automatically convert a BaZi pattern into a fact about the customer's present life.

Instead, the BaZi result is preserved as a method projection. PHI OS then distinguishes calculated structure from interpretation, and interpretation from evidence about current Reality. When present-day information is available, the system may compare the birth-based structure with the customer's actual circumstances rather than assuming that the two are identical.

The purpose is not to decide the customer's life for them, but to help them see what this perspective highlights, what deserves observation, what can be compared with Reality, and what remains unknown.
keyBlocks: Read the four pillars, seasonal context and registered relationships as an interpretive structure.
en.boundary: Interpretive presentation, not objective proof or a prediction.
en.alt: HOW DOES PHI OS USE BAZI?

zh-Hans.title: PHI OS 如何看待并使用八字？
zh-Hans.subtitle: 保留八字的结构与时间读取，同时把结果放回现实中检验。
zh-Hans.body:
PHI OS 不把八字当作一个能够单独解释整个人生的绝对答案，而把它视为一种结构与时间视角。八字负责提供自己的计算结果与结构关系；PHI OS 不重新发明四柱、五行或时间规则，也不会因为某个命局出现某种结构，就直接把它转换成关于客户现实的确定事实。

在 PHI OS 中，八字的结果首先被保留为一个方法投影，然后再区分哪些属于确定计算结果、哪些属于解释、哪些需要结合其他证据才能成立。当客户提供当前现实、资源、关系、工作或环境信息时，系统可以进一步比较出生结构与正在发生的现实，而不是假设两者必然相同。

因此，PHI OS 使用八字的目的不是替客户决定人生，而是帮助客户看见一种结构视角：哪些主题可能值得观察，哪些关系可能需要进一步验证，以及哪些地方仍然属于未知。
keyBlocks: 把四柱、季节背景和已登记的关系作为解释性结构来阅读。
zh-Hans.boundary: 解释性呈现，不是客观证明或预测。
zh-Hans.alt: PHI OS 如何看待并使用八字？

en.title: HOW TO READ THIS REPORT
en.subtitle: Separate calculation, interpretation, current evidence, and open questions so you can see what is established, what is conditional, and what still needs observation.
en.body:
Not every part of this report has the same level of certainty. Some information comes directly from the BaZi calculation, such as the Four Pillars, Stem–Branch structure, Five Element relationships, and admitted timing positions. Other content is interpretive and must be understood in relation to the wider structure and its conditions. Some comparisons only become possible when current information about work, relationships, resources, environment, or lived circumstances is available.

For that reason, the report distinguishes four states: Calculated, Interpreted, Current Evidence, and Open. When a statement comes from the method structure, its source should remain traceable. When an interpretation depends on conditions, those conditions should remain visible. When evidence is insufficient, the report should not convert uncertainty into a definitive claim.

You do not need to treat every sentence as a conclusion. The more useful approach is to notice what matches your Reality, what appears only under particular conditions, what deserves further observation, and what still remains open.
keyBlocks: Read the four pillars, seasonal context and registered relationships as an interpretive structure.
en.boundary: Interpretive presentation, not objective proof or a prediction.

zh-Hans.title: 如何阅读这份报告
zh-Hans.subtitle: 把计算、解释、现实证据与未知分开，你会更容易知道哪些内容值得相信、比较与继续观察。
zh-Hans.body:
这份报告不会把所有内容放在同一个确定性层级。八字中有些内容来自明确计算，例如四柱、干支、五行关系与已经确定的时间位置；有些内容属于对这些结构的解释，需要结合条件与整体关系理解；另一些内容只有在客户提供当前生活、工作、关系、资源或环境资料后，才可以进一步与现实比较。

因此，每一页都会尽量区分四种状态：已计算、解释、当前证据、仍待观察。当一个结论来自方法结构，我们会说明它来自哪里；当它需要现实条件才能成立，我们会保留条件；当现有资料不足，我们不会为了让报告显得完整而补成确定答案。

阅读这份报告时，不需要把每一句都当作结论。更有价值的方式，是观察哪些结构与你的现实相符，哪些只在特定阶段出现，哪些值得继续验证，以及哪些地方暂时仍然开放。
keyBlocks: 把四柱、季节背景和已登记的关系作为解释性结构来阅读。
zh-Hans.boundary: 解释性呈现，不是客观证明或预测。
